summary: DevSpace MCP tunnel/connectivity is now part of deploy readiness as an optional profile. Validate the real local/public MCP endpoint, workspace reuse and bounded write/test flow on the target development PC.
decisions: Tunnel DevSpace MCP only, not the Studio Web/API.
Keep provider credentials and machine-specific state outside Git.
Support ngrok and Cloudflare as replaceable transport providers.
Reuse one valid workspaceId per project root/session.
Do not treat ChatGPT host capability failures as proof that tunnel or workspace is down.
known_risks: Conversation/runtime may not expose Developer MCP even when tunnel is healthy
next_action: Run the connectivity doctor locally and with --require-public, then verify one ChatGPT DevSpace workspace can be reused for a bounded read/write/test task.
